caption: Same 305 natural proteins. MarinFold supplies exact top-L/2 predicted contacts, with no MSA or oracle seeds; three Helico samples, ranking_score selection. Oracle supplies two random L/2 true-contact subsets, selecting within each and averaging; one target has 109 rather than 110 oracle contacts. All seven predictors and no-contact Helico retained. See MARINFOLD_L2.md and ORACLE_L2.md. Neff is recomputed on the exact frozen predictor alignments: sum of inverse neighbor counts at >=80% identity over jointly non-gap columns. Repeated sequences are downweighted; no alignment or prediction is changed. Bins are <10, 10–<100, 100–<1000 and >=1000. Means and 95% intervals bootstrap proteins; cohort membership changes relative to raw depth. Split, viral and design views remain separate. Every score, Neff measurement and contributing protein traces through neff_figure_rows.csv, neff_summary.csv and NEFF_ANALYSIS.md.
